We need to output a JUnit 4 test file ElementsTest.java, with start marker ###Test START## and end marker ###Test END##. Must comprehensively test all methods in Elements class. Since Elements depends on jsoup library classes (Element, FormElement, Node, etc). In test environment, we can use jsoup library. We'll write tests that create a Document, parse HTML, get Elements via select, and then test methods: constructors, clone, attr, hasAttr, eachAttr, attr setter, removeAttr, addClass, removeClass, toggleClass, hasClass, val getter/setter (use input elements), text, hasText, eachText, html, outerHtml, toString, tagName, html setter, prepend, append, before, after, wrap, unwrap, empty, remove, select (should return filtered), not, eq, is, next/prev/nextAll/prevAll with and without query, parents, first, last, traverse, filter, forms.

Will need to implement NodeVisitor for traverse, NodeFilter for filter.

We'll use JUnit 4 annotations: @Test, @Before.

We'll import org.jsoup.Jsoup, org.jsoup.nodes.Document, org.jsoup.nodes.Element, org.jsoup.nodes.FormElement, org.jsoup.select.Elements, org.jsoup.select.NodeVisitor, org.jsoup.select.NodeFilter, org.jsoup.nodes.Node.

We'll create a sample HTML with nested structure.

Test examples:

- testCloneDeepCopy: modify original after clone to ensure deep.

- testAttrHasAttrEachAttr: set attribute on some elements.

- testAddRemoveClassToggleHasClass.

- testValGetSet: input type="text".

- testTextEachTextHasText.

- testHtmlOuterHtmlToString.

- testTagName.

- testHtmlSetPrependAppendBeforeAfterWrap.

- testUnwrapEmptyRemove.

- testSelectNotEqIs.

- testSiblingMethods: create list of <li> elements within <ul>, test next, nextAll, prev, prevAll with query.

- testParents.

- testFirstLast.

- testTraverseCollectNodeNames.

- testFilterRemoveCommentNodes? But filter using NodeFilter to remove nodes? We'll just collect visited nodes.

- testForms: include <form>.

We'll need to assert expected strings.

Make sure to handle edge cases like empty Elements.

Write each test method.
